pages.text: Now the good part: the &6Masters&r. Five trades keep Skyhaven fed and armed: mining, foraging, farming, fishing and combat. Each has a master who'll teach you, sell you tools and, if you're polite, give you a starter kit.
Start with &6Tamsin Deepholt&r, the mining master, and she'll point you on to the others. They're all marked on your map. That's what the little faces are.
